criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 29 April 2028 (12 months after the 29 April 2027 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.

Identifies that the Calloway Media Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Yarrow Systems Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (12 months) and as a date (29 April 2028), with days remaining from 29 March 2027 (397 days).
Notes that 29 April 2028 is a Saturday and that the release moves to the next Business Day, 1 May 2028.
Where a defined term or clause is ambiguous, explains how each alternative reading would work.
